facts.fact: The ministry's EMIS helpdesk gives the procedure for recording student attendance in OpenEMIS on the web: under the institution, by academic period, week, day, class and grade, each student is present by default and is changed to an excused or unexcused absence; it is an instruction, not a report that schools do it, and the page is undated, so its published date is used.
The attendance guide is issued by the EMIS helpdesk of the Ministry of Education, Skills, Youth and Information; the page is undated, so its published date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Skills, Youth and Information
systems.tiers: institution (school), by class and education grade

note: A seven-step user guide and nothing else. It names no level, no school and no count, and its published date is a proxy for a standing page; the parent should weigh the kept fact as a procedure, not as evidence of use.
